VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2287½

SHANGHAI, 7th July 1931

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. & S. B. REGS. No. S. B. D. 842. date 8 - 7 - 31.）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I would be much obliged to receive some information if possible concerning :

Hermann WITZ, of German nationality, teacher of biology at the Tung Chi University Middle School at Woosung, born at Göttingen 2 March 1992, domiciled at Shanghai, Royal Hotel, Range Road, holder of a German passport No. 183/29 issued at Göttingen on 17 August 1929, on which his portrait shows him with a moustaché, which he does not have at the present time.

Mr. Witz stated that he intended visiting Netherlands India in company of Miss Dr. GRZYMACL, of German nationality, teacher of French at the Ching Hua University at Peking, in order to study the fauna and the flora of Java during the summer holidays.

In view of the fact that the German teachers of the Tung Chi University have on more than one occasion shown radical tendencies in politics, I thought it worth while to enquire into his antecedents before issuing a visa to him.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chinese Secretary.

（左侧手写批注：* No record in C. & S. B. Reg. (Room 325) （签名） 9/7. Nothing in A.O. records （签名） 6/7）

R. C. Alers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,
SHANGHAI.

谨此奉告，如蒙提供有关以下人士的信息，本人将不胜感激：

赫尔曼·维茨（Hermann WITZ），德国籍，吴淞同济大学附中生物学教师，1992年3月2日生于哥廷根，寓居上海北四川路皇家饭店，持有1929年8月17日于哥廷根签发的德国护照第183/29号，护照照片显示其留有胡须，但目前并无胡须。

维茨先生称，他打算与葛里马克尔（GRZYMACL）小姐（音译）一同前往荷属印度，葛里马克尔小姐为德国籍，任教于北京清华大学法语教师，他们计划利用暑假研究爪哇岛的动植物群。

鉴于同济大学德籍教师曾多次表现出激进的政治倾向，我认为在向维茨签发签证前，有必要调查其背景。

SHANGHAI, 2nd July 1930.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Dr. Jozef HEINE,
of German nationality, born at Ellwangen on May 10th 1895,
a professor of medicine at the Tungchi University and
attached to the Paulun Hospital, residing at No. 34 Route
de Grouchy, has applied to this Consulate General for a
visa to the Netherlands East Indies, where he wishes to
spend a few weeks' vacation.

I venture to enquire whether anything from a point of
view of morals or of politics is known to the Police against
this person. As far as I remember some of the personnel of
the abovementioned University at the time proved to have some
communistic affiliations.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Vice Consul.

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Acting Director of Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

C. I. D. REGIST.
No. I. O. D. 842.
Date 13 - 1 - 30.

January 13, 30

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter, No. 3919 of December 31, 1929, on
the subject of Herr Otto Rettberg. In reply I wish
to state that the person named, so far as is known,
is not imbued with dangerous political ideas. While
employed in the Tungchi University, Woosung, he did
not show any leanings towards Communism or associate
with professors or students who believed in that cult.
Rettberg is, nevertheless, said to be very disgruntled
at present in consequence of his inability to find
employment, and his desire to visit Java results from
a hope that he will be able to overcome this difficulty
there.

Rettberg was employed in the Chinese Customs
from 1901 to 1914.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

A Director of Criminal Investigation.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

Date January 10, 1930.

Subject (in full) Herr Otto Rettberg.

Made by Temp. Cl. Asst Cook. Forwarded by Jno Robertson (D. I).

Herr Otto Rettberg, since he left the Customs
service in 1914 where he served since 1901, has
become a dissatisfied individual due chiefly to
unsuccessful employment. He endeavoured to obtain
a position with the German Mission at Nanking, but
did not succeed. He is not dangerous as regards his
political views and although he served in the Tunchi
University at Woosung he had no connections whatever
with the "Red professors" there. His wife, who arrived
recently from Germany, possesses funds. The reason
for his wishing to proceed to Java is to look for
employment.

Jno Robertson
T. I. A.

SHANGHAI, 31st December 1929.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr. Otto Rettberg,
of German nationality, described in his passport as a bank-
employee, born at Grosse Schneen near Göttingen on 23 Feb.
1877, applied on 24th December 1929 with this Consulate
General for a visé for Netherlands India.

A German passport No. 203 was issued to him on 7th
October 1926 by the German Consulate General at Batavia,
since when he appears to have lived mostly in China. His
last occupation here was that of a teacher of the German
language at the Tunchi University at Woosung.

He stated that he intended to travel to Australia and
showed a visé to that effect issued by the local British
Consulate General on 18th December 1929, and said that he
would only travel through Java in transit.

He intended to leave by the "Khyber" the following day
and he was informed by this Consulate General that no visé
could be issued at once. He was further advised to apply
again with the Netherlands' Consulate General at Singapore.

Mr. Rettberg called three times in all on that day and,
when further questioned, stated that he did not intend to
go to Australia at all, but would try to find a position in
the Netherlands East Indies.

His wife remained at Shanghai, where her address is at
631 Avenue Foch.

The University at Woosung has, as far as I know, a
doubtful reputation and the German teachers employed there
have been mentioned on more than one occasion as spreading

The Director of Criminal Investigation,

上海，1929年12月31日

先生：

谨此奉告，奥托·雷特贝格（Otto Rettberg）先生，德国籍，护照上职业描述为银行职员，1877年2月23日生于哥廷根附近的格罗斯·施内恩（Grosse Schneen），于1929年12月24日向本总领事馆申请前往荷属印度的签证。

他持有1926年10月7日由巴达维亚德国总领事馆签发的德国护照第203号，此后似乎主要居住在中国。他在此地的最后职业是吴淞同济大学德语教师。

他声称打算前往澳大利亚，并出示了当地英国总领事馆于1929年12月18日签发的相应签证，并称他将仅经停爪哇。

他打算次日乘坐“开伯尔”号（Khyber）轮离境，本总领事馆告知他无法立即签发签证。并建议他向新加坡荷兰总领事馆再次申请。

雷特贝格先生当天总共来访三次，经进一步询问，他声称根本不打算去澳大利亚，而是试图在荷属东印度寻找职位。

其妻留在上海，地址为霞飞路631号。

据我所知，吴淞的大学声誉不佳，受雇于那里的德国教师曾多次被提及散布

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3919

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 842.
Date 4 - 1 - 30

SHANGHAI, 31st December 1929.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr. Otto Rettberg,
of German nationality, described in his passport as a bank-
employee, born at Grosse Schneen near Göttingen on 23 Feb.
1877, applied on 24th December 1929 with this Consulate
General for a visé for Netherlands India.

A German passport No. 203 was issued to him on 7th
October 1926 by the German Consulate General at Batavia,
since when he appears to have lived mostly in China. His
last occupation here was that of a teacher of the German
language at the Tunchi University at Woosung.

He stated that he intended to travel to Australia and
showed a visé to that effect issued by the local British
Consulate General on 18th December 1929, and said that he
would only travel through Java in transit.

He intended to leave by the "Khyber" the following day
and he was informed by this Consulate General that no visé
could be issued at once. He was further advised to apply
again with the Netherlands' Consulate General at Singapore.

Mr. Rettberg called three times in all on that day and,
when further questioned, stated that he did not intend to
go to Australia at all, but would try to find a position in
the Netherlands East Indies.

His wife remained at Shanghai, where her address is at
631 Avenue Foch.

The University at Woosung has, as far as I know, a
doubtful reputation and the German teachers employed there
have been mentioned on more than one occasion as spreading

The Director of Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

上海，1929年12月31日。

先生：

谨此通知，奥托·雷特贝格（Otto Rettberg）先生，德国籍，护照载明职业为银行职员，1877年2月23日出生于哥廷根附近的格罗斯·施内恩（Grosse Schneen），于1929年12月24日向本总领事馆申请荷属印度签证。

他持有的德国护照（第203号）系1926年10月7日由巴达维亚德国总领事馆签发，此后他似乎主要居住在中国。他在本地的最近一份职业是吴淞同济大学的德语教师。

他声称打算前往澳大利亚，并出示了当地英国总领事馆于1929年12月18日签发的相应签证，并称他将仅以过境方式途经爪哇。

他打算次日乘坐“开伯尔”号（Khyber）轮离境，本总领事馆告知他无法立即签发签证。此外，建议他向新加坡荷兰总领事馆再次提出申请。

雷特贝格先生当天总共来访三次，经进一步询问，他称根本不打算去澳大利亚，而是试图在荷属东印度群岛寻找职位。

其妻留在上海，住址为霞飞路631号。

据我所知，吴淞的那所大学声誉不佳，受雇于该校的德国教师不止一次被提及在学生中及校外传播

上海公共租界工部局警务处

红色宣传。
直到最近，该校还有一位名为德雷斯勒博士（Dr. Dreskler）的教师，他于今年10月29日去世，系德国共产党党员。
若贵处近期获悉有关该机构的任何不利情况，特别是雷特贝格先生是否与其某些同事在该校进行的活动有任何关联，本人将不胜感激。
